items.briefing:
There are no breaking cyber threats specific to Australia in today's articles, but the broader theme of AI security risks remains relevant to all Australian organisations. Multiple reports highlight growing concerns around AI governance — many businesses are adopting AI tools faster than they are putting proper oversight and security controls in place. This gap increases the risk of data misuse or exposure, particularly as staff use AI platforms in their daily work.

On the scam front, Scamwatch continues to monitor active threats targeting Australians. Stay vigilant about unsolicited emails, especially those using AI-generated content that may appear highly convincing.

**Tip:** Before using any new AI tool at work, check with your IT or management team that it's approved — not all AI platforms handle your data safely.
